about: The egress bundles Sluse Admin offers (D-038 point 5). A config holds the bundles chosen and every host written out; only the hosts are enforced, and a newer catalog never widens a box by itself. 'measured' says what of a bundle was measured, when and how, or is null where its hosts are still the M9 draft.

bundles.name: The box's own system
bundles.description: Ubuntu's updates, patched in place, and the Snap store for Firefox.

bundles.name: Claude Code and Claude Desktop
bundles.description: Anthropic's inference and sign-in, Claude Desktop's application hosts and package repository, Claude Code's installer and updates, claude.ai's connectors and artifacts.
bundles.measured: 2026-10-06, version 3: hcaptcha.com and *.hcaptcha.com, claude.ai's sign-in page's bot check (L1: js.hcaptcha.com refused, and the email code then failed with "could not verify your browser"); a wildcard does not take its apex, so both. Not added: accounts.google.com, the page's Google sign-in, refused beside it; the email sign-in does not need it. 2026-10-05, version 2: the hosts from Anthropic's own lists, Claude Code's network requirements (code.claude.com/docs/en/network-config) and Claude Desktop's narrowed list (code.claude.com/docs/en/desktop), after the box on fjeder's device refused platform.claude.com and Claude Code would not start (ERR_PROXY_TUNNEL). Left out: storage.googleapis.com (any Cloud Storage bucket, an upload channel; only /plugin's counts and installers before 2.1.116), the Datadog telemetry hosts, *.livepreview.claude.ai and *.livepreview.claude.app (app preview, which serves the box's local apps out), bridge.claudeusercontent.com is inside *.claudeusercontent.com. Before: 2026-10-02, the Claude Code installer on the dev guest: claude.ai, downloads.claude.ai, api.anthropic.com

bundles.name: Codex and ChatGPT
bundles.description: OpenAI's inference and sign-in, Codex's installer, and ChatGPT's desktop app, its package repository and live connection.
bundles.measured: 2026-10-02: the Codex installer on the dev guest, behind the proxy; chatgpt.com redirects to releases.openai.com, which serves the script and the binary. First use not measured. ChatGPT's hosts read from its package's code, 2026-10-26, not measured; its telemetry hosts (Statsig) left out. 2026-10-28, L1: OpenAI's sign-in page loads its styles and scripts from auth-cdn.oaistatic.com (refused, the page unstyled and dead); refused and left out: chat.openai.com, ab.chatgpt.com, files.openai.com, web-sandbox.oaiusercontent.com, Google's and GitHub's sign-in hosts

bundles.name: Mistral Vibe
bundles.description: Mistral's inference endpoints, EU and global, and the sign-in for Mistral Vibe. Signed in with a Mistral account, Vibe uses the global endpoint, which has no EU location commitment. Vibe itself installs from PyPI.
bundles.measured: 2026-10-28, L1: Vibe's sign-in needs auth.mistral.ai and v2.auth.mistral.ai, which the bundle lacked (refused by the proxy). 2026-10-29, L1: signed in, every prompt went to api.mistral.ai and chat.mistral.ai, not the EU endpoint the box's config names. The rest of its hosts not yet measured

bundles.name: Python packages
bundles.description: PyPI's index and downloads. Not its upload host.

bundles.name: Node.js and npm
bundles.description: npm's registry and Node.js's downloads. The registry also takes publishes.

bundles.name: GitHub
bundles.description: Cloning, releases and raw files. GitHub also takes pushes, issues and gists.

bundles.name: Microsoft sign-in, opened by the person
bundles.description: For signing the AI apps in with your organisation's Microsoft account. The box reaches these hosts only while the person opens a sign-in from the Sluse window, five minutes at a time; never otherwise. Pair it with Conditional Access requiring a compliant device for Office 365 and Sluse Gate.
bundles.measured: 2026-10-05, L1: the hosts of Claude's and ChatGPT's Entra sign-in, by the proxy's refusals (D-044); WorkOS is Claude's single sign-on. 2026-10-29, L1: Claude's sign-in with Microsoft needs sso.claude.com; ChatGPT's Continue with Microsoft goes to login.live.com, personal accounts only, left out (jok): ChatGPT signs in by device code. Mistral's not yet measured
